text:
Ajay: kicking off canary for release v2.14.3 -> eu-west. starting at 10% for 15m. DeployBot start healthwatch. @Maria @Kevin FYI
DeployBot: START deploy canary_id=cb-1717001234 release=v2.14.3 env=eu-west traffic=10% window=15m
ObservabilityBot: initial SLO snapshot: embed_p95=82ms (SLO 100ms), errors_5m=0.3% (SLO 0.5%), token_rate=1.2k rps. dash: https://console.redwood/s/dash/1717001234
Maria: seeing p95 spike on /generate-embeds to ~210ms from a subset of hosts. no 5xx. sample log: ```host=eu-west-2a service=embed latency=210ms```
Kevin: can we pin embed route to the older quant model for canary? fallback exists to model:v2.14.2-quant if needed
Tara: rollback thresholds reminder: p95>300ms OR 5xx>0.8% sustained for 2m. watch gpu-pool-3 mem and kvcache rates
Ajay: holding and throttling to observe. @DeployBot set-traffic 10%->5%
DeployBot: traffic updated: 5%
ObservabilityBot: 2m check: embed_p95=195ms, errors_5m=0.45%, mem_gpu=68% (gpu-pool-3). kvcache_miss rate elevated on subset
Maria: KV cache miss looks correlated with quant change, likely cold KV/cache regen causing tail latencies
Kevin: agree. propose route pin for canary: ```route "embed" -> model:v2.14.2-quant if canary==true```
Tara: +1. after pin, observe 5m before further ramp.
Ajay: applying pin now. @DeployBot apply-route-pin embed canary model:v2.14.2-quant
DeployBot: route pin applied. canary traffic remains 5%
ObservabilityBot: 5m after pin: embed_p95=92ms, errors_5m=0.22%, mem_gpu=63% — SLOs within range :thumbsup:
Ajay: ramping to 25% over 3m. note for release: pinned embed route during canary due to KV miss-induced tail. closing in 30m unless new alerts
Maria: added trace links and logs to release notes.
Kevin: filing a follow-up to improve KV warmup in rollout docs
Tara: good catch, thanks team.
